title: Last Gladiators: Digital Pinball
overview:
Tilt Your Brain and Let the Flippers Fly!

No more crowded arcades! No more token machines! No more smoke-filled bowling alleys! Digital Pinball is now in your hands... with all the fluid ball movement, realistic sounds and control you'd find in an arcade pinball machine. Cradle the ball on the flipper, fire at your target and nudge both sides of the machine as you rack up billions of points. Nail the right targets and experience multiple ball sessions with as many as five balls shooting up ramps, flying off bumpers or bearing down on your overwhelmed flippers. All this great pinball action is accompanied with ever-changing, hard-driving rock-n-roll music recorded by professional studio musicians. So put your feet up, crank up the volume and let the flippers fly!

- Play up to four completely different pinball games
- Fluid, accurate ball physics and authentic game sounds
- Realistic Nudge/Tilt feature recreates the arcade experience of moving the machine and controlling the ball
- Energetic rock-n-roll background music created by professional studio musicians
- Lively bumpers and flippers, elevated rails and ramps, and hidden portals keep the ball in motion
